-- TODO: Replace with actual source document query
-- Returns new/updated documents for active patients
-- Checksum-based dedup: only sync if checksum changed
SELECT
  p.mrn,
  d.document_id,
  d.document_type,
  d.document_name,
  d.document_date,
  d.file_path AS source_file_path,
  d.file_size_bytes,
  d.checksum
FROM source_documents d
JOIN bcp_active_patient p ON p.mrn = d.mrn AND p.is_active = true
LEFT JOIN bcp_patient_pdf_document existing
  ON existing.mrn = d.mrn AND existing.document_name = d.document_name
WHERE existing.checksum IS NULL OR existing.checksum != d.checksum

INSERT INTO bcp_patient_pdf_document (
  tenant_id, source_system, mrn, patient_id,
  document_type, document_name, document_date,
  file_path, file_size_bytes, checksum, last_synced_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}',
  'HIS',
  '{{ $json.mrn }}',
  NULL,
  '{{ $json.document_type }}',
  '{{ $json.document_name }}',
  {{ $json.document_date ? "'" + $json.document_date + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.local_file_path }}',
  {{ $json.file_size_bytes || 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.checksum }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, source_system, mrn, document_name)
DO UPDATE SET
  file_path = EXCLUDED.file_path,
  file_size_bytes = EXCLUDED.file_size_bytes,
  checksum = EXCLUDED.checksum,
  document_date = EXCLUDED.document_date,
  last_synced_at = NOW();

UPDATE bcp_sync_status SET
  sync_status = 'SUCCESS',
  last_sync_completed_at = NOW(),
  last_success_at = NOW(),
  records_synced = {{ $items().length }},
  error_message = NULL
WHERE sync_component = 'PDF_DOCUMENT'
  AND tenant_id = '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}';
